+# Security Fix: XXE Vulnerability
+
+## Vulnerability Identified
+
+**Type:** XML External Entity (XXE) Injection
+
+**Severity:** Critical
+
+**Location:** `ConfigService.java` - `loadConfig()` method
+
+## Description
+
+The original code created `SAXParserFactory` and `TransformerFactory` instances with default settings that allow external entity processing. This vulnerability allows attackers to:
+
+1. **Read local files** - Access sensitive files on the server (e.g., `/etc/passwd`, configuration files)
+2. **Perform SSRF attacks** - Make requests to internal network resources
+3. **Cause Denial of Service** - Trigger billion laughs attacks or other resource exhaustion
+4. **Exfiltrate data** - Send data to external servers
+
+## Fix Applied
+
+### 1. SAXParserFactory Hardening
+
+Added three security features to prevent XXE attacks:
+
+```java
+factory.setFeature("http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl", true);
+factory.setFeature("http://xml.org/sax/features/external-general-entities", false);
+factory.setFeature("http://xml.org/sax/features/external-parameter-entities", false);
+```
+
+- **disallow-doctype-decl**: Completely blocks DOCTYPE declarations (most secure)
+- **external-general-entities**: Disables external general entity references
+- **external-parameter-entities**: Disables external parameter entity references
+
+### 2. TransformerFactory Hardening
+
+Added attributes to restrict external access:
+
+```java
+transformerFactory.setAttribute(XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD, "");
+transformerFactory.setAttribute(XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_STYLESHEET, "");
+```
+
+- **ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD**: Prevents loading external DTDs
+- **ACCESS_EXTERNAL_STYLESHEET**: Prevents loading external stylesheets
+
